title: IBM 3270 P0 current state
summary: The current P0 line is a native 24x80 Model-2 IBM 3270 engine with traditional TN3270 first, basic TN3270E negotiation, executable host reads/structured fields, extended attributes, operator input, detached snapshots, evidence-backed MVS/TK5 known states, and the generic one-writer/many-reader ownership gate.
invariants: Traditional TN3270 remains first-class; TN3270E is used only for functions genuinely negotiated and implemented.
READ BUFFER, READ MODIFIED and READ MODIFIED ALL preserve native 3270 field/MDT semantics rather than flattening the presentation space.
SFE, SA and MF attributes remain in the model and READ BUFFER reconstruction; NONDISPLAY values are masked in detached snapshots.
Write Structured Field and Query Reply advertise only capabilities actually implemented.
Once TN3270LiveSession is claimed by TerminalSessionOwner, direct mutation fails closed and one-writer control passes through TerminalControlGate.
TSO READY requires a complete trimmed row exactly equal to READY; loose READY substrings are not authentication evidence.
The TK5 ISPF Primary Option Menu requires corroborating title, Option prompt and END instruction markers; recognition grants no PF/AID authority.
Terminal meter facts use the configured protocol source; TN3270 evidence must never be emitted as TN5250.
Downstream MVS Intention may consume Terminal Machine observations but does not acquire terminal mutation authority or MVS/JES semantic authority.
AID send completion is not host semantic completion; callers must advance on observed presentation generation/known state, not a scripting API return convention.
missing_work: Differentially qualify Terminal Machine candidate12 and s3270 against the same live ED209Z session/LU, then repeat independently on ED209ZZ, comparing fields, protection, MDT, cursor, keyboard and visible content.
Requalify the MVS Intention dev9 native Terminal Machine consumer against candidate12/current source; preserve dev9's candidate8 result as historical provenance rather than rewriting it.
Capture a live Terminal Machine ISPF snapshot and compare it with the retained TK5 Figure 17 reference without promoting documentation evidence to live authority.
Adopt Socket Provider only when its concrete TCP connection exposes a qualified non-blocking readiness contract; do not unwrap raw provider internals to force the migration.
Add optional TN3270E BIND/RESPONSES/SYSREQ semantics only when negotiated and fully implemented; never claim optional functions speculatively.

provenance.claim: Records candidate12 scope, inherited r13196 evidence and the reference/live authority distinction.
Downstream consumer evidence: native TN3270LiveSession usage, terminal fact projection, exact READY gating and clean LOGOFF; qualified historically against candidate8.
